upaṭṭhāsi.cp: aor. of upatiṭṭhati. stood by; looked after.
upaṭṭhāsi.p: [Upa+ṭhā+ī] (kri) CL=7 (A) He was established or appeared (in the mind). See - Upaṭṭhāti-(A). (B) He took care of and served. He attended. See - Upaṭṭhāti-(B).
a: ဥပဋ္ဌာသိ(ကြိ)
(က)ထင်ပေါ်လာပြီ။ ဥပဋ္ဌာတိ-(က)-ကြည့်။(ခ)ပြုစုလုပ်ကျွေးပြီ၊ ဆည်းကပ်ခစားပြီ။ ဥပဋ္ဌာတိ-(ခ)-ကြည့်။

B:
upaṭṭhāsi： upaṭṭhāsi（kri）
ဥပဋ္ဌာသိ（ကြိ）
«upa+ṭhā+ī»
[ဥပ+ဌာ+ဤ]
C: upaṭṭhāsi：[aor．of upatiṭṭhati] stood by； looked after．（aor．of upaṭṭhāti），waited or attneded on； cared for； nursed．
